verdict.rationale: cubic lets users define custom agents, which are review rules stored in cubic.yaml, and these run automatically on every new pull request. It also offers configurable automatic actions on PR events: auto-approval against a review policy, auto-fix on every review, and auto-resolve of fixed threads. However, these are fixed, PR-scoped toggles rather than a general rule engine where users pick arbitrary trigger events and arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: user-definable event triggers beyond PR review events, arbitrary configurable actions (no outbound/webhook-style actions documented), and independent hands-on corroboration of the automation behavior.
